short_name.notes: Official acronym used across 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.1 and ipsa.fr.

min_standing_note.value: Minimum 2 years of undergraduate study in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electronics Engineering, Robotics, or related fields required; home university nomination required (Aero 3 UG, Aero 4 Spring GR, Aero 5 Fall GR).

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Normalized from agreement_scope_raw == 'University-wide' (note IPSA is a specialized aerospace engineering school requiring STEM background).

eligible_majors.notes: Normalized from agreement_scope_raw == 'University-wide' (engineering prerequisite background noted in min_standing_note & course_restrictions_note).

english_course_availability.notes: Aero 3 (UG, Fall & Spring) offers English or French tracks; Aero 4 (GR, Spring) is English track; Aero 5 (GR, Fall) is English track except Management option.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Recommended CEFR B2 English for English-track courses: TOEIC 700/990, TOEFL iBT 70/120, IELTS 5/9, Duolingo 100/160, or a letter from the home university confirming sufficient English proficiency (no RHET 1020 exemption stated).

host_language_requirement.value: None required for English-track Aero 3/4/5 courses; CEFR B2 French recommended for French-track Aero 3 and for the Aero 5 Management option. Free French lessons (FLE) and intercultural courses offered.

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Orientation days 1 week before program start; Undergraduate (Aero 3) late August – mid-January; Graduate (Aero 5) late September – end of January.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Orientation days 1 week before program start; Undergraduate (Aero 3) mid-January – end of May; Graduate (Aero 4) February – June.

tuition_model.notes: AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.2 Budget table explicitly lists Tuition fee: Waived for exchange students.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Summed from AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.2 monthly budget lines: Accommodation 600-900 EUR/month + Food 300 EUR/month + Transportation 32 EUR/month = 932-1,232 EUR/month (excludes one-time 50 EUR VLS-TS visa fee).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Converted from midpoint 1,082 EUR/month (range 932-1,232 EUR/month) over 5 months: 1082 EUR * 5 * FX rate 1.1052 USD/EUR = 5,979.13 USD. FX rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD from ECB Euro reference exchange rates for 2026-11-13 (latest prior to 2026-11-15), retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition fee waived; VLS-TS visa fee 50 EUR. EU students must present a valid EHIC upon arrival; non-EU students must enroll in the free French student social security scheme once in France (complementary health insurance recommended). Civil (third-party) liability insurance is mandatory for all students.

housing_availability.notes: IPSA provides access to its partner's dedicated student housing platform (student residencies and offers with personalized rental support).

housing_notes.value: Access to IPSA's partner student housing platform offering student residencies and rental support; estimated accommodation 600-900 EUR/month. EU students renting in France may receive CAF APL housing allowance (up to 210 EUR/month per 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.2).

host_grants_or_stipends.value: CAF personal housing allowance (APL, up to 210 EUR/month) for EU students renting accommodation in France; Campus France scholarships vary by home country (no AUC-specific incoming IPSA stipend confirmed).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU students staying 4 months to 1 year require a French VLS-TS long-stay student visa (50 EUR fee; official portal https://france-visas.gouv.fr/en/web/france-visas/). Processing lead time and exact EUR/month solvency proof vary by country/consulate via France-Visas.

course_catalog_url.notes: No public static exchange course catalog URL; updated course lists are emailed directly to nominated students as soon as available (AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.2).

english_course_list_url.notes: Updated course lists (including English tracks for Aero 3/4/5) are emailed directly to nominated students by IPSA (AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.2).

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS; full-time degree workload is 30 ECTS per semester (exchange students may take fewer credits if allowed by their home university).

course_restrictions_note.value: Aerospace engineering curriculum (Aero 3 UG, Aero 4 Spring GR, Aero 5 Fall GR); requires >=2 years UG study in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electronics Engineering, Robotics, or related fields. Paris-Ivry campus offers all programs; Toulouse campus is exclusively graduate and does not offer all options/majors. Aero 5 Management option requires B2 French + English.
course_restrictions_note.notes: Program tracks and Aero 5 Management French rule on p.2; >=2 years STEM background from https://www.ipsa.fr/en/programmes/exchange-programs/.

value: Home university nomination (via IPSA online form)
Proof of language proficiency (test certificate or home university letter)

academic_style.value: CTI-accredited French aerospace engineering grande école offering specialized tracks in aeronautics, space systems, robotics, and propulsion, complemented by 90+ student clubs.
academic_style.notes: CTI-accredited engineering degree profile noted via https://www.ipsa.fr/en/programmes/exchange-programs/.

campus_type.notes: AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.1 lists two exchange campuses: Paris-Ivry (63 bis bd de Brandebourg, Ivry-sur-Seine) and Toulouse (81 av. de Grande Bretagne).

international_support_services.value: Orientation days 1 week before program start; buddy system, free French language (FLE) and intercultural courses, cultural activities with the international student association, 90+ clubs, and partner housing platform support.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall 2026: Nomination Apr 15, 2026, Application May 15, 2026; Spring 2027: Nomination Oct 15, 2026, Application Nov 15, 2026.
